CustomField.description: Subset of Applicable_Models__c. Models listed here will pre-seed this template as a default row when the setup flow creates campaigns for that model. Stored as a semicolon-separated string. Leave blank for library-only templates. MultiselectPicklist is not supported on CMDT, so this is a Text field with a known value set enforced by convention.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Semicolon-separated list of models where this template is a pre-seeded default. Leave blank to make this template available only via the library picker. Valid values: Seasonal, GivingPrograms, Strategy.
CustomField.label: Default In Model
